blocks.name: Core Courses-36 hours (Credits listed are in hours)

notes: Noncredit certificate counted in hours: the catalog states 'Credits listed are in hours' and a total of 36; each course is 18 hours.
The catalog prints the codes without a space (FDSVB74NC, FDSVB75NC); they match closed-list FDSV B74NC and FDSV B75NC and are not treated as catalog additions.
The description mentions 'work opportunities in domestic and commercial kitchens'. These are workplaces rather than named careers, so no careers are recorded. A reviewer may want to check this.
